messages:
emma-prod: Heads-up team — new "Inspector Access" policy for Private/VPC is going live tomorrow. This standardizes how auditors, inspectors, and third-party assessors get temporary access. Read the doc and ACK.

noah-sre: Link? Top-level changes?

emma-prod: Doc: https://redwood.internal/policies/inspector-access-v1. Key points: time-limited tokens (default 12h), scoped RBAC, mandatory attestation PDF, and an audit manifest produced automatically. Also a required customer consent checkbox before we enable full trace exports.

rachel-legal: Important: external auditors must sign our Inspector Access Agreement and an NDA prior to token issuance. We'll need CRM evidence before granting full trace access. I'll attach templates to the doc.

tom-sales: Can AE request these on behalf of customers? Whats the turnaround SLA?

emma-prod: Yes, AE can initiate. Default turnaround is 48h for standard requests, 4h for expedited (paid). Pricing & process for expedited requests are in the doc.

audit-bot: Policy note: tokens issued via /admin/issue_inspector_token will be logged with issuer id and expiry. Manifest file: s3://private-manifests/<customer>/<req_id>.json

noah-sre: Infra note: we'll enforce token TTL and automatic revocation, plus a short-lived host-side cert. I'll push the RBAC enforcement to staging today.

devex: DevEx will create two templates: (1) customer-facing inspector intro, (2) AE playbook for requesting access. ETA EOD today.

rachel-legal: Also flag: if a customer requests an auditor to access full payloads we need a signed data-access addendum. Default bundles will redact PII.

tom-sales: ACK — will brief AEs and add a CRM field for attestation tracking.

noah-sre: ACK — RBAC & revocation hooks in place on staging.

devex: ACK — templates uploading shortly.

emma-prod: Thanks. Action summary:
- noah-sre: enforce TTL/revocation, RBAC (due today)
- rachel-legal: attach templates + data-access addendum (due today)
- devex: customer & AE templates (due EOD)
- tom-sales: update AE playbook + CRM (due tomorrow)

Please reply here with ACK when youre done. If anything blocks, report it. :lock:
